payload.body: Shipped @fricken/server app-route kit: setCors/handlePreflight, sendJson, readJsonBody (1MiB cap + JsonBodyTooLargeError), matchPath (:param), authenticateRequest (bearer→session→Principal; role left to app). 8 tests in app-route-kit.test.ts; full server suite 760 green. aquariusyacht + Zavro can drop their runtime/http.ts copies and FrickStore-derived Principal type.
